name: NotifySync (Beta)
description:
🧪 BETA CHANNEL — Pre-release versions of NotifySync for testers. Use the regular repository for stable installs.

NotifySync transforms the Jellyfin interface by adding a native notification bell, inspired by major streaming platforms. Your users instantly see the latest additions — Movies, Series, Music — without ever leaving their current page.
